## Checklist
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build` pass
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG.md` updated (Unreleased)

- [ ] No mention of officers, rank or connections; no fabricated names, numbers or testimonials
- [ ] Prices only from `src/lib/pricing.ts`; brand strings only from `src/lib/site.ts`
- [ ] No AI attribution in commits or description
